LanguageData.RK_XenoType_Ratkin.label: Ratkin
LanguageData.RK_XenoType_Ratkin.description: The origins of the Ratkin are unclear, but they are descendants of humans who developed rat-like traits to survive in harsh environments. They are skilled at growing plants and mining, making them capable pioneers. However, because they are small and have poor eyesight, they traditionally relied more on farming than hunting.\n\nRatkins can be difficult to distinguish by sex, and most have small bodies and cute faces. This helps them form social bonds, but can also make diplomacy more difficult.
LanguageData.RK_XenoType_Ratkin.descriptionShort: Ratkins are descendants of humans who evolved to survive in harsh places. They are skilled at growing plants and mining. However, their small bodies and poor eyesight pushed them toward farming rather than hunting. They are difficult to distinguish by sex, and most are small and cute in appearance.
